17:36 < Filip> ok, page 97, table 5.1:
17:36 < Filip> Reset NMI 0xBFC0 000
17:36 < Filip> TLB Refill 0xBFC0 0200
17:37 < Filip> XTLB Refill 0xBFC0 0280
17:37 < Filip> Cache error 0xBFC0 0300
17:37 < Filip> all other exceptions 0xBFC0 0380
17:39 < Filip> want more infoon those ?
17:39 < antagonizt> pg 97?
17:39 < antagonizt> from your book?
17:40 < Filip> yep. TLB refill is basically a cache miss, refilling the address translation table
17:40 < Filip> TLB=32bits, XTLB=64
17:41 < Filip> these addresses are only valid for sR(BEV)==1
17:41 < Filip> meaning uncached, startup-safe kseg1
17:44 < Filip> so it's jumping to 0xbfC002F0 , probably becaus it has got more room there (for not running into the  0xBFC00200 TLB Refill )
17:45 < Filip>  0x9FC006F0
17:45 < Filip> what lives there ?
17:46 < antagonizt> not in the rom
17:46 < Filip> noop, but might be a hardware register
17:47 < Filip> like one of the hard buttons ?
17:47 < antagonizt> where did you get 0x9FC006F0 from?
17:48 < Filip> we should also make a memory map with all know regions 
17:48 < Filip> dissasmbled 0xBFC002F0
17:48 < Filip> that's where NMI jumps to
17:49 < antagonizt> did you load the whole mem dump?
17:49 < Filip> no, the dump is starts at 0xBFC00000
17:49 < Filip> so first byte in the file is NMI
17:50 < Filip> 0x0000200 is TLB Refill
17:50 < Filip> etc
17:51 < Filip> (make sure to use mipsl in IDA Pro)
